plaatsen.tekst: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest
If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
